programs.title: Heartland Homicide
programs.desc: Near Gunnison, Colo., Jake Millison goes missing; the outcome seems grim as the months wear on, but a break in the case unravels the mystery behind his disappearance, revealing a greed-fueled plot far more sinister than anyone can imagine.

programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: A beloved teacher is brutally murdered in her own home just days before Christmas, leaving a community in shock; for 25 years, the case remains unsolved, until an unexpected break in DNA technology reveals a connection no one sees coming.

programs.title: My Sister's Double Life
programs.desc: When Chelsea's sister vanishes after a late-night shift at a diner, she tries to convince the police that she's been abducted. Racing against the clock, she soon discovers that her sister's captor is now after her as well.

programs.title: My Mother Stole My Life
programs.desc: A woman steals her estranged daughter's identity to escape from an abusive boyfriend. However, when he tracks her down, she finds herself in even more danger.

programs.title: Don't Open the Door
programs.desc: A man discovers the body of a woman inside a suitcase; despite the killer's grisly attempt to obscure her identity, detectives identify the victim as 28-year-old swimsuit model Jasmine Fiore.

programs.title: Barons
programs.desc: Mac turns up in Woogonga and calls in a debt that Snapper can't pay; Trotter races to win back Tracy and LightWave; Buddy and Hunter finally have to face the truth about their future together.
